name: Boston Baked Beans
summary: Pea beans baked all day with salt pork, molasses and mustard, after Fannie Farmer.
ingredients: 4 cups pea beans or navy beans

equipment.help: This is six to eight hours at a low heat, so what matters is how steadily your oven holds it.
equipment.label: Oven

steps.title: Soak the beans overnight
steps.body: Pick the beans over, cover them well with cold water and leave them overnight.
steps.note: They swell to more than twice their size, so use a bigger bowl than looks necessary.

steps.title: Parboil them
steps.body: Drain, cover with fresh water, and heat slowly until the skins burst when you blow on a spoonful.
steps.note: Farmer's test is exact: blow on a few beans in a spoon, and the skins split.

steps.title: Scald the pork
steps.body: Scald the salt pork, scrape the rind, and cut a half inch slice from it.

steps.title: Pack the pot
steps.body: Put the slice of pork in the bottom of the bean pot. Fill with drained beans and bury the rest of the pork, leaving the rind just showing.

steps.title: Measure the molasses
steps.body: Molasses is what makes these beans dark and sweet rather than merely cooked.

steps.title: Mix the sauce
steps.body: Stir the molasses, salt, mustard and sugar into a cup of boiling water and pour it over the beans.

steps.title: Top up with water
steps.body: Add boiling water until the beans are just covered.

steps.title: Heat a gas oven to 250°F
steps.body: Gas cycles its burner. Set the pot in the middle and check the water every hour or two.

steps.title: Heat an electric oven to 250°F
steps.body: Electric holds a low heat steadily, which suits a long bake like this one.

steps.title: Heat a convection oven to 225°F
steps.body: Drop the heat for the fan, and keep the lid on: moving air dries the top out fast.

steps.title: Bake covered
steps.body: Bake with the lid on, adding boiling water whenever the beans look dry.
steps.note: Six hours is the point of this dish. The beans go from mealy to creamy near the end.

steps.title: Uncover to brown
steps.body: Take the lid off for the last half hour so the pork rind crisps and the top browns.

steps.title: Serve hot
steps.body: Serve from the pot, with brown bread if you have it.
